title: Spotify Metadata Scraper
description: Extract public Spotify metadata from tracks, artists, albums, playlists, shows, and episodes. No Spotify login or API key is required.

startUrls.title: Spotify URLs or URIs
startUrls.description: Spotify web URLs or spotify: URIs, one per line.

maxItems.title: Maximum input items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of unique Spotify URLs to process.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of Spotify pages fetched in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. The public embed endpoint usually works without a proxy.
